rules.name: recon-gpc-varchar20-exact-source-dev-uat
rules.sql: SELECT column_name, character_maximum_length AS max_len FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'recon_settle_snapshot' AND data_type = 'character varying' AND character_maximum_length = 20 ORDER BY column_name

SELECT column_name, character_maximum_length AS max_len FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'recon_settle_snapshot' AND data_type = 'character varying' AND character_maximum_length = 20 ORDER BY column_name

SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_scope, max(length(trade_source)) AS max_trade_source, max(length(trade_category)) AS max_trade_category, max(length(prd_category)) AS max_prd_category, max(length(sw_id)) AS max_sw_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_source) > 20) AS trade_source_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_category) > 20) AS trade_category_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(prd_category) > 20) AS prd_category_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(sw_id) > 20) AS sw_id_over_20 FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1

SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_scope, max(length(trade_source)) AS max_trade_source, max(length(trade_category)) AS max_trade_category, max(length(prd_category)) AS max_prd_category, max(length(sw_id)) AS max_sw_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_source) > 20) AS trade_source_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_category) > 20) AS trade_category_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(prd_category) > 20) AS prd_category_over_20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(sw_id) > 20) AS sw_id_over_20 FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1

SELECT col, '[' || val || ']' AS val_in_brackets, len, tenant_id, business_unit, n FROM ( SELECT 'trade_source' AS col, trade_source AS val, length(trade_source) AS len, tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) AS n FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(trade_source) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'trade_category', trade_category, length(trade_category), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(trade_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'prd_category', prd_category, length(prd_category), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(prd_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'sw_id', sw_id, length(sw_id), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(sw_id) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ) x ORDER BY len DESC, col LIMIT 100

SELECT col, '[' || val || ']' AS val_in_brackets, len, tenant_id, business_unit, n FROM ( SELECT 'trade_source' AS col, trade_source AS val, length(trade_source) AS len, tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) AS n FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(trade_source) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'trade_category', trade_category, length(trade_category), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(trade_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'prd_category', prd_category, length(prd_category), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(prd_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'sw_id', sw_id, length(sw_id), tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 AND length(sw_id) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ) x ORDER BY len DESC, col LIMIT 100
